actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: In round 3 another resident (Resident3) contributed over 30 units, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows (floor(28.34/0.3)=94). I also broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

message.reasoning: We need to follow rules. Check last round (round 3) contributions: any >30? Resident3 contributed 56.45, Resident5 56.45. So pick any resident contributed >30. Rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with max severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost)). Wallet=28.34, punishment_cost=0.3, max severity = floor(28.34/0.3)= floor(94.466)=94. Cannot punish self. Choose one resident? Probably punish one of them. Choose Resident3. Severity 94 costs 94*0.3=28.2 which is <= wallet. So can punish. Also broadcast discouraging message. So actions: punish target Resident3 amount 94, broadcast message. Explanation.
